macos.rationale: Current quickstart and download pages agree: macOS 12+ Apple Silicon/64-bit Intel, Windows 10 64-bit+, Linux and Googlebook. Scope: Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity CLI, Antigravity IDE, Remote Control.

windows.rationale: Current quickstart and download pages agree: macOS 12+ Apple Silicon/64-bit Intel, Windows 10 64-bit+, Linux and Googlebook. Scope: Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity CLI, Antigravity IDE, Remote Control.

linux.rationale: Current quickstart and download pages agree: macOS 12+ Apple Silicon/64-bit Intel, Windows 10 64-bit+, Linux and Googlebook. Scope: Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity CLI, Antigravity IDE, Remote Control.

web-client.rationale: Remote Control accesses local hosts. Remote Agents offers vendor-managed conversations in desktop/mobile browsers for eligible Pro/Ultra personal accounts. Scope: Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity CLI, Antigravity IDE, Remote Control.

mobile-web.rationale: Remote Control works from a mobile browser, with optional home-screen web app. Scope: Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity CLI, Antigravity IDE, Remote Control.

ios.rationale: Remote Control explicitly has no native mobile app; the installable home-screen application is the browser web app.

android.rationale: Remote Control explicitly has no native mobile app; the installable home-screen application is the browser web app.

cli.rationale: Antigravity CLI (agy) installs on macOS, Linux, Googlebook and Windows per the install docs. Release notes for CLI v1.2.15 (Oct 2, 2026; staged rollout) add prebuilt native Android binaries that run in Termux; the install page does not mention Android. Scope: Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity CLI, Antigravity IDE, Remote Control.

byo-subscription.rationale: Free plan, Google AI Pro, Google AI Ultra and Gemini Enterprise Standard/Plus. Scope: Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity CLI, Antigravity SDK.

local.rationale: Agents run locally in 2.0, CLI and IDE. Scope: Remote Control, Antigravity CLI, Antigravity SDK, Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity IDE.

own-server.rationale: Remote Control connects to existing server, desktop or laptop; daemon on Linux, macOS, Windows. Scope: Remote Control, Antigravity CLI, Antigravity SDK, Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity IDE.

vendor-cloud.rationale: Remote Agents runs in Google-managed environments and continues while local devices sleep, for Pro/Ultra personal accounts. Separately the Gemini API offers preview managed sandboxes. Scope: Remote Control, Antigravity CLI, Antigravity SDK, Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity IDE.

worktree.rationale: Current projects documentation supports a new worktree per conversation, and subagent branch mode creates an isolated Git worktree. The v2.30.0+ Knowledge Work layout uses project folders without offering the conversation worktree selector.

container.rationale: The official sandbox guide explicitly calls its Linux namespace sandbox OS-level container boundaries. Scope is the local Linux terminal sandbox, not Docker-image management or the macOS Seatbelt implementation.

parallel-runs.rationale: Multiple conversations and agents run in parallel; worktree mode isolates them. Scope: Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity CLI, Antigravity IDE.

coordinator.rationale: Custom subagents and Teamwork roles support messaging, result return, live progress and follow-up; cross-harness delegation was not found. Scope: Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity CLI.

unattended-triggers.rationale: 2.0 Automations (renamed from Scheduled Tasks in v2.21.1) and CLI /schedule (one-time timer or recurring cron job). The preview Gemini API agent adds cron triggers with an IANA time zone. Scope: Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity CLI.

sso.rationale: Single sign-on flow; BYOID uses Workforce Identity Federation to authenticate through an external identity provider "such as Okta". Scope: Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity CLI. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to antigravity:TEAM-02; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

review-ui.rationale: Code diffs are artifacts. Scope: Antigravity IDE, Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity CLI.

telemetry-opt-out.rationale: Settings > Account toggle and CLI enableTelemetry. Scope: Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity CLI, Antigravity IDE.

free-tier.rationale: Individual plan costs $0/month with basic weekly rate limits. Scope: Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity CLI.

starting-price.rationale: Individual plan costs $0/month with basic weekly rate limits. Scope: Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity CLI.

laptop-independent.rationale: Remote Control needs its host online; Remote Agents keeps executing independently of the user machine. Scope: Remote Control, Antigravity CLI, Antigravity SDK, Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity IDE.

roles.rationale: Gemini Enterprise defines administrator and user IAM roles controlling Antigravity access. This does not establish per-task or project collaboration roles. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to antigravity:TEAM-02; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

review.note: The two named roles are Google Cloud Discovery Engine IAM prerequisites. The cited page says only who needs each one and sends readers to an external setup guide, so it documents no workspace/organization role permissions inside the ADE.

per-seat.rationale: Business Standard/Plus from $30 per seat per month.

usage-based.rationale: AI credits consumed at Gemini Enterprise consumption pricing; pay-as-you-go option.

no-paid-plan.rationale: The complete pricing page lists paid Google AI Pro/Ultra and Business subscription/consumption options alongside the free plan.

subscription.rationale: Google AI Pro/Ultra and Business subscription options are explicitly offered on the pricing page.

one-time.rationale: The complete public plan list has free, recurring subscription and consumption options and omits a one-time ADE purchase.

claude-code.rationale: The documented runtime is the Antigravity harness across app/CLI/IDE/SDK clients; the model table selects models rather than third-party coding CLI harnesses. claude-code is not a harness choice in that product architecture.

antigravity.rationale: The main application, agy CLI and SDK explicitly run the Antigravity harness.

license.rationale: Main application/service use is governed by vendor-authored Google/Antigravity terms. Apache-2.0 applies to SDK source only, not to the main application.

paid-from.rationale: The lowest publicly stated monthly paid amount on the checked Antigravity page is eligible Gemini Enterprise Standard/Plus at $30 USD per seat/month. Pro/Ultra have no amount stated on this page; eligibility/plan restriction is retained.
